products.tagline_zh: The browser where Claude Code and Codex work beside you
products.description_zh: Rill is an AI-native browser built around the Claude Code and Codex you already use. products.name: AUDR by Chargebee
products.tagline_zh: Open standard for tracking agent run costs
products.description_zh: AUDR (Agent Usage Detail Record) is an open standard, for capturing who initiated an agent run and what it cost across every system that run touches. Inspired by the telecom industry's Call Detail Record, AUDR defines a common JSON schema that any harness, router, or billing system can emit and ingest. Three core rules make it work: a shared run ID minted by the harness, clear field ownership, and strict merge rules where conflicts are rejected and corrections are new records.

products.name: Ghostifier
products.tagline_zh: Companies have your data. Ghostifier gets them to delete it.
products.description_zh: Instead of one form per company, Ghostifier starts from your inbox. It finds who holds your data, unsubscribes you and opts you out of sale and sharing on day one, waits out the return window, then sends deletion requests and tracks every reply. Banks, insurers and your employer are left alone. It also asks data brokers to delete you. Gmail access is headers only, so it never reads your email bodies, and there is no AI: every decision follows fixed rules.
